Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0, Stage 4, Shadar Logoth. Asset draghkar-buffet.png. Canvas exactly 1536×1024. Exactly 8 frames in a 4×2 grid. Each cell is 384×512. Clear gaps, no overlap, no borders. Frames, in reading order: 1. buffet windup 2. buffet 3. buffet wide 4. buffet back 5. hurt 1 6. hurt 2 7. hurt 3 8. hurt 4. Genuinely transparent background, real alpha. No painted backdrop, floor shadow, or checkerboard. Native facing is LEFT, matching Stage 2 enemies; the game mirrors the sprite to turn. HOUSE STYLE, identical to spike-art/HOUSE_STYLE.txt: HOUSE STYLE (Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0), identical for every image:
- Hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game sprite art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4: confident dark-brown/near-black ink outlines (thicker on the outer silhouette, thinner inside), clean cel shading with 2-3 tone steps plus subtle painterly gradients. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D render, NOT photo-real, NOT chibi.
- Lighting baked lightly: soft key light from the upper LEFT, gentle cool rim on the right edge. Keep shading moderate (the game adds real-time light on top).
- Rich but grounded colors. Strong readable silhouette.
- Side view (profile / slight 3/4), character faces RIGHT, full body head to boots, whole figure inside the frame with margin.
- Genuinely TRANSPARENT background (real alpha). No ground shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no borders, no frame numbers. Wing buffet and hurt. Top row a wing shove. Bottom row hurt flinches. No blood. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, frame labels, or borders in the finished image. No gore: Shadowspawn become ash; human cultists are knocked out or flee.
